summary: Review case studies and customer stories for attribution, denominators, timeframe and evidence transferability.

must_inspect.why: Outcome claims are hard to interpret without knowing what changed relative to what baseline and denominator.
false_positive_guards: Do not demand a denominator for purely qualitative claims.

must_inspect.why: A customer outcome can coexist with multiple simultaneous causes; wording should not silently imply exclusive causality.
false_positive_guards: Do not downgrade first-party testimony merely because it is qualitative; calibrate the claim instead.

must_inspect.why: A selected success story is evidence of possibility, not automatically typical performance.
false_positive_guards: Do not demand population statistics when the artifact makes only a bounded example claim.
